scenes.title: 9 years of gross Airbnb income to cover a typical 2-bed's price in Jamaica
scenes.vo: About nine years. That's how long a typical two-bed Airbnb in Jamaica takes to gross its own asking price.
A typical two-bed is listed at about a hundred and eighty-four thousand pounds, or two hundred and forty-six thousand US dollars.

scenes.desc: Monthly gross at 60% occupancy, from a £90 median nightly rate
scenes.vo: At ninety pounds a night and sixty percent occupancy, it grosses about sixteen hundred and forty pounds a month.
As a long let at seven hundred and eighty-eight pounds a month, it's nearer twenty years. Both are gross, before costs and voids.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
